violations.title: Packaged Food Labels
violations.observation: The following packaged food items is not properly labeled as specified in Law: OBSERVED HOUSE-MADE BOTTLED DOOGH (ESTABLISHMENT WAS BOTTLING DRINK IN THE ESTABLISHMENT) THAT DID NOT MEET ALL LABELING REQUIREMENTS.
violations.corrective_action: Packaged food shall be labeled as specified in Law, including 21 CFR 101 Food Labeling, 9 CFR 317 Labeling, Marking Devices, and Containers, and 9 CFR 381 Subpart N Labeling and Containers, and as specified under 3-202.17 and 3-202.18. PIC AGREED TO DISCONTINUE THIS PROCESS TEMPORARILY UNTIL LABELS ARE MADE WITH ALL REQUIRED INFORMATION. PLEASE WORK WITH THE EHS TO ENSURE THESE LABELS HAVE ALL REQUIRED INFORMATION PRIOR TO BOTTLING DRINKS AGAIN.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food items were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED SLICED TOMATOES AT 47-50F, FETA AT 46-48F, DICED TOMATOES AT 49F, FETA #2 AT 49F, COOKED SPINACH AT 44F, FETA CRUMBLES AT 49F AT TWO-DOOR PREP-TOP. OBSERVED RAW CHICKEN AT 49F IN ONE DOOR UPRIGHT COOLER.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC DISCARDED OR MOVED FOOD ITEMS DURING INSPECTION. PIC UNDERSTANDS COLD HOLDING FOODS SHOULD BE KEPT AT 41F OR BELOW. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED CORRECTION.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: OBSERVED THE TWO-DOOR PREP-TOP AT 45-46F.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. PIC DISCARDED OR MOVED FOOD ITEMS OUT OF TEMPERATURE TO ANOTHER COOLER DURING THE INSPECTION. PIC UNDERSTANDS THIS COOLER SHOULD NOT BE USED UNTIL IT HAS BEEN REPAIRED AND CAN MAINTAIN TEMPERATURES BETWEEN 34-38F.
